Sid was leading at ten miles, but here Payne overtook him and went on to break the record for the course, a distinction which Warboys also shared. H. Bignall, another International Marathon runner and a second-claim Belgrave man, was third.

Carter, one of our first-year runners, was entrusted with the last stage, and as the two International runners, E. Harper (Hallamshire H.) and H. Bignall (Highgate H.) were over three and a half minutes behind, there was little to worry about.
